literal: Wealth we lost saying will not grieve, resolve certainly in hand those who possess.
translation: Those who possess unwavering resolve as a certain asset in hand will not grieve, saying, 'We have lost our wealth.'
modern: ஊக்கத்தை உறுதியான கைப்பொருளாகக் கொண்டவர்கள், 'செல்வத்தை இழந்துவிட்டோமே' என்று வருந்தமாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme value of inner motivation and resolve over material wealth. The poet explains that those who hold onto determination as their secure, permanent possession in hand will never despair when they lose external riches. They understand that material wealth can be lost and regained, but as long as they possess inner drive, they have the ultimate resource to rebuild. Thus, they remain untroubled by temporary setbacks, knowing their true strength lies within.
